product_metadata.title: HuaLan 3-Piece Food Grade Silicone Spatula Set Non Stick Dishwasher Safe Flexible Rubber Silicone 600ºF Heat-Resistant Spatulas Cooking Kitchen Utensil- Black
features: FLEXIBLE SILICONE TURNER SPATULAS - The heat-resistance silicone blades is flexible, which make cooking easier flipping and fun. Great for flipping eggs, pancake, fish, burgers, pizzas and dishes without scratching.

REINFORCED S-CORE INTERNAL STAINLESS STEEL - The strength and flexibility of our stainless steel blade core and handle means that these utensils will hold up to the demanding use of home cooks and professional chefs and won't break like cheap plastic store brands.

HEAT-RESISTANCE SPATULAS WITH SUPERIOR SILICONE - The spatulas are made of strong and durable stainless steel metal core, which is coated with flexible silicone and can withstand up to 600°F high temperature.
ANTI-SLIP AND ERGONOMIC DESIGN HANDLE - The soft non-slip grip is easy to hold and the ergonomically designed handles with thumb groove ensure maximum comfort and control.

DISHWASHER SAFE AND SATISFIED GUARANTEE - All HUALAN kitchenware come with 100% full warranty. If you are not satisfied with our products, please let us know and you will be offered with a full refund or free replacement.
